input.question: Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, Why I've never heard about them before, and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car?
input.ground_truth: > Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, They sell a unique product that is considered very trendy. > Why I've never heard about them before, You don't go outside much, read newspapers very often, or trade stocks. Seriously, the name Tesla is everywhere on reddit, even. They are a young company though, so that might be part of the issue. > and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car? Brand new high tech cars aren't cheap. You'd be lucky to pay less than 60 grand for even the most basic model. Also, many people have concerns about the battery range and recharging safety/convenience.

Question: Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, Why I've never heard about them before, and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a really cool, super fast toy car that can drive by itself a little bit, and it doesn’t need to go to the gas station very often because it runs on electricity. That’s kind of like a Tesla car! Tesla makes these really fancy, cool cars that are different from most cars you see.

Now, why haven’t you heard about them before? Well, sometimes, new things take a while to become famous. Maybe you haven’t seen one in your town yet, or maybe they are a bit more expensive, like a super special toy that not everyone can buy right away.

Also, most people still have the kind of cars they’re used to. It’s like if everyone at school has a red crayon, and you bring a blue crayon. Some people will think, “Wow, that’s cool!” but others might just keep using their red crayon because it’s what they know.

But Tesla cars are getting more and more popular, just like how a new game at school can become everyone’s favorite after a while!
